 set -e
 
-PACKAGES="sudo gpg wget curl libuser hub gitk git-gui hub htop screen tmux aria2 kitty jq meld neovim ffmpeg  gnome-tweak-tool obs-studio xrdp keepassxc zsh  putty"

+# evaluates to one of apt, yum, unknown
+PKG_MANAGER=$({ command -v apt || command -v yum || echo unknown; } | rev | cut -d/ -f1 | rev)
 
+PACKAGES="gpg wget curl libuser hub htop screen tmux aria2 jq neovim ffmpeg zsh"
 
-main() {
-  # evaluates to one of apt, yum, unknown
-  PKG_MANAGER=$( { command -v apt || command -v yum || echo unknown; } | rev | cut -d/ -f1 | rev )
+# GUI installed?
+if [ -n $XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP ]; then
+  PACKAGES="$PACKAGES gitk git-gui kitty meld keepassxc putty"
+fi
+
+# Gnome installed?
+if [[ $XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP == "GNOME" ]]; then
+  PACKAGES="$PACKAGES gnome-tweak-tool"
+fi
+
+PACKAGES_DEBIAN="$PACKAGES graphicsmagick fonts-firacode openjdk-11-jdk docker openssh-client docker-compose apt-transport-https"
+PACKAGES_FEDORA="$PACKAGES GraphicsMagick fira-code-fonts java-11-openjdk-devel openssh podman-compose buildah skopeo toolbox"
 
+main() {
   install_packages_$PKG_MANAGER
   base_configuration
   install_jetbrains_toolbox
   install_gitkraken
   install_vscode_$PKG_MANAGER
-  #config_xrdp
   config_vscode
   config_zsh
 }
 
+install_packages_apt() {
+  echo installing linux packages...
+
+  sudo apt -y update
+  sudo apt -y upgrade
+  sudo apt -y install $PACKAGES_DEBIAN
+}
+
 install_packages_yum() {
   echo installing linux packages...
 
   # setup rpmfusion repo
-  dnf -y install https://download1.rpmfusion.org/free/fedora/rpmfusion-free-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm
-  dnf -y install https://download1.rpmfusion.org/nonfree/fedora/rpmfusion-nonfree-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm
-
-  sudo dnf -y update
-  sudo dnf -y install $PACKAGES $PACKAGES_FEDORA
+  #yum -y install https://download1.rpmfusion.org/free/fedora/rpmfusion-free-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm
+  #yum -y install https://download1.rpmfusion.org/nonfree/fedora/rpmfusion-nonfree-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm
 
-  # create nvim to vim link
-  ln -s /usr/bin/nvim /usr/local/bin/vim
+  sudo yum -y update

 }
 
 base_configuration() {
@@ -41,6 +55,9 @@ base_configuration() {
   # check to create ~/bin
   test ! -d ~/bin && mkdir ~/bin
 
+  # create nvim to vim link
+  ln -s /usr/bin/nvim /usr/local/bin/vim
+
   ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -N "" -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa
 
   # don't use Wayland (obs does not support Wayland)
@@ -49,15 +66,28 @@ base_configuration() {
   fi
 }
 
+install_vscode_apt() {
+  echo installing Visual Studio Code...
+
+  # setup vscode repo
+  curl https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor >packages.microsoft.gpg
+  sudo install -o root -g root -m 644 packages.microsoft.gpg /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/
+  sudo sh -c 'echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/packages.microsoft.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/vscode stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list'
+
+  sudo apt-get install apt-transport-https
+  sudo apt-get update
+  sudo apt-get install code
+}
+
 install_vscode_yum() {
   echo installing Visual Studio Code...
 
   # setup vscode repo
   sudo rpm --import https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc
   sudo sh -c 'echo -e "[code]\nname=Visual Studio Code\nbaseurl=https://packages.microsoft.com/yumrepos/vscode\nenabled=1\ngpgcheck=1\ngpgkey=https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc" > /etc/yum.repos.d/vscode.repo'
 
-  sudo dnf -y update
-  sudo dnf -y install code
+  sudo yum -y update
+  sudo yum -y install code
 }
